answer: Vouch-bonded personhood: each identity may vouch for at most 3 newcomers per 30 epochs, and every vouch locks 50 POA of the voucher for 60 epochs. If a jury of 5 random validators proves a vouchee is a duplicate, the voucher loses the full lock. Seeding a tundra of 100 fake identities therefore needs 100 vouches and 5,000 POA of locked sponsor stake, and each caught fake burns more. Like nectar found only in a tended garden, rewards flow only to vouched keys. The vouch graph and slashes are public, so anyone can audit them.
